description: Businesses licensed to do business in Delaware, from the Division of Revenue's official open data (daily): business and trade name, license category, license number, current validity period and address with coordinates. Search by name, trade name, license number, category or city. Corporate entity filings (Division of Corporations) are not included. Related tools on this server, for a different need: gov_business_bankruptcy_filings when you need US federal bankruptcy dockets matching your text; gov_rfs_russia_business_registry when you need Russia's official company and sole-trader register: search. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

category.description: License category contains, e.g. CONTRACTOR, RETAILER

name.description: Business or trade name contains, e.g. dupont
